proof_scope: Visual reviewer evidence gate for Tau creator-reviewer DAGs

claims.proves: Tau blocks fake visual reviewer PASS receipts that claim represents_goal/attractive without screenshot-bound evidence, and accepts the equivalent reviewer verdict when the screenshot path, sha256, mocked, and live fields are present and readable.
claims.does_not_prove: Human aesthetic acceptance, provider semantic quality, React Flow rendering, or GOAL.md completion.

what_was_exercised: local commands declared in the fixture manifest
what_remains_unverified: semantic correctness, live services, LLM judge behavior, and release readiness

claims.description: Tau creator-reviewer DAGs reject visual-quality reviewer PASS claims unless the reviewer verdict is bound to a readable screenshot path, exact sha256, and mocked/live proof boundary.
